name: Kyrgyzstan
summary: A red field with a golden sun in the centre, its rays straight, holding a stylised tündük, the crown of a yurt. The 1992 design was revised in 2023 to straighten the sun's rays.
origin: After independence from the Soviet Union, Kyrgyzstan adopted a red flag with a sun of 40 wavy rays and a tündük on 3 March 1992.
In 2023 Parliament approved a revised version with straight rays, after President Sadyr Japarov argued the wavy rays looked like a sunflower; the law was signed in December 2023.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: Valour and bravery; red is said to have been the colour of the banner of the hero Manas.

symbols.name: Sun with 40 rays
symbols.description: A golden sun with forty rays.
symbols.meaning: Peace and wealth; the forty rays stand for the forty Kyrgyz tribes united by the epic hero Manas.

symbols.name: Tündük
symbols.description: Crossed lines within the sun, depicting the wooden crown of a yurt.
symbols.meaning: The home, the unity of the people and the world.

facts: The Epic of Manas, the national epic, is one of the longest poems in the world.
The 2023 redesign was controversial; critics said it was unnecessary.
The tündük is the round opening at the top of a yurt.
clues: A golden sun with 40 rays on red, holding the crown of a yurt.
Its rays stand for forty tribes united by an epic hero.
Its sun's rays were straightened in 2023 after being likened to a sunflower.
